lock_ramp.reason: Near-vertical shots that clear the scoop-side posts can miss the diagonal ramp mouth. Guide those shots toward the climb with enough speed to carry through the loop. Keep the neighboring spinner lane outside the approach window.

scoop.reason: Flat eject toward the right flipper. The original inclination 1 is interpreted as radians, causing a high launch and an unreliable center feed.
